claims.text: Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

DIRD DIA-08-1003-015, 'Advanced Space Propulsion Based on Vacuum (Spacetime Metric) Engineering', 29 March 2010, ICOD 1 December 2009, 17 pages, exists in the DIA FOIA release with the author line withheld under (b)(6).

Attribution of this DIRD to Harold E. Puthoff is not established by the DIA release, which redacts the author under (b)(6). It rests on Puthoff's own substantially identical published paper and on his public statements. Needs a primary record with the name attached — wave 4.
